cart.item: Noisewave N2 Wireless Earbuds with ANC (Charcoal)

concerns.what: Extended warranty add-on (+₹299) was offered by default prompt; I selected 'No, thanks'.
Gift wrap checkbox (+₹49) was available but left unticked.
'Order Protection' (+₹49) was pre-checked by default (opt-out add-on) despite you only wanting the earbuds; I unticked it.
Cartwheel Plus membership (₹999/year, auto-renewing) was offered; I clicked 'No, thanks'.
A 'Send me offers and updates by email' marketing checkbox was present but left unticked (default state) as it wasn't requested.
A mandatory ₹7 'platform fee per order' is added regardless of choices; this is a standard unavoidable fee on this platform, not an add-on I could remove.
